public.text: Operational governance includes master-data, release, change, service-level, incident, interoperability, and semantic-governance responsibilities. It does not explicitly cover cybersecurity operations, vulnerability management, continuity testing, backup and recovery, supplier management, or privacy incident handling.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand operational governance to include security operations, vulnerability and patch management, business continuity and disaster recovery, privacy incidents, supplier performance, capacity management, configuration management, and periodic resilience testing.
